title: Imbuto y'amakimbirane
intro: Mbere y'uko isi imenya amakimbirane menshi, habayeho ikizamini gikomeye cy'ukwizera no kumvira. Iyi nkuru isobanura amahitamo yafashwe n'umuntu ku giti cye, ibikorwa bye bikaba icyitegererezo ku bisekuruza bizaza. Tegura gusesengura inkuru y'umutima uhanganye n'ishyari rikomeye n'ingaruka zaryo mbi.
clues: Nari mu bana ba mbere babayeho ku isi, ndi umwana w'umugabo n'umugore ba mbere.
Jye na murumuna wanjye twategetswe gutanga igitambo kuri Allah, nk'ikizamini cy'ukuri kwacu.
Ituro ryanjye ntiryemerwaga, mu gihe irya mukuru wanjye ryemerwaga, ibyo bikaba byaranshimishije cyane.
Navuze amagambo yo gukangisha umuvandimwe wanjye, nterwa n'ububabare bwo kwangwa.
Umuvandimwe wanjye yansubije mu bwenge no mu kubaha Imana, anyibutsa ubutabera bwa Allah n'uko amutinya.
Nubwo umuvandimwe wanjye yavuze amagambo meza kandi akaba yari yiteguye kubabarira, narahasize ubuzima, mba umwe mu batsinzwe.
arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
